# `.context/idea/` — Constitution (Phase 1)

Outputs of `/project-foundation` Phase 1 — Constitution. Captures **why** the product exists before any scope decisions.

## Expected files (generated by `/project-foundation`)

| File                  | Purpose                                                                |
| --------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `business-model.md`   | Business Model Canvas — problem, solution, value prop, segments, etc. |
| `market-context.md`   | Industry positioning, competitive analysis, market trends             |
| `legacy-analysis.md`  | Existing-code analysis (legacy projects only — tech stack, doc gaps)  |

Skill references that drive generation:
- `.claude/skills/project-foundation/references/constitution-business-model.md`
- `.claude/skills/project-foundation/references/constitution-market-context.md`

## Outcome

After Phase 1 the project has the anchor every later phase assumes: the rationale, the customers, the competitive context. PRD (`.context/PRD/`) builds on top of this.

## When to re-run

- Major product pivot
- New MVP cut
- Significant market repositioning

Otherwise, this directory is written once and rarely touched.
